recipes.title: Sweet Potato Brownies (Healthy, Gooey)

items.i: small sweet potato, roasted and mashed
oat flour (more if your sweet potato is big)
dark chocolate chips, plus extra for the top

steps: Roast the sweet potato at 425°F for about 50 minutes until soft, then mash.
Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking dish with parchment.
Mix the mashed sweet potato with the eggs, maple syrup and vanilla (and honey if you like), using an immersion blender until smooth.
Add the cacao, oat flour, salt and baking soda and mix until combined, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour into the dish, sprinkle with more chips and bake 30–45 minutes (she does 40). They stay softer than regular brownies.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's version of wellwithkaija's brownies. She gives no macros or pan size; the macros are my estimate for 9 squares from an 8-inch pan.
